trigger: Workflow 30204103060 retrieved 4,894 canonical Swap logs across five frozen windows and verified all four pools, but made more than one thousand per-block timestamp RPC calls. Blockscout returned HTTP 429 before the sixth window, leaving 123 otherwise-decodable logs without timestamps.

change.window_boundaries: Use twelve bounded Blockscout getblocknobytime requests instead of repeated binary-search block calls.
change.swap_logs: Use the same four pools, six one-hour windows and Swap topic with one bounded range request per pool-window; bisect only explicit provider range-limit errors.
change.timestamps: Collect unique block numbers first and request eth_getBlockByNumber in JSON-RPC batches of at most 80 while preserving exact block identity.
change.rate_limits: Honor Retry-After or exponential backoff and classify persistent transport failure as SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, never source scarcity.
change.authority: No previously retrieved log is selected by outcome; the unchanged source gate is recomputed from all six frozen windows.

unchanged: factory token and canonical pool identities
minimum four dense windows and 100 logs
zero decode errors and duplicate identities
all model features labels payoff and thresholds
